meta.title: Add .cursorignore to optimize AI editor performance and security
meta.body_summary: Add a .cursorignore file to exclude sensitive files (keys, credentials) and large generated artifacts (build outputs, node_modules) from Cursor AI indexing, aiming to improve editor performance and security.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor added a .cursorignore config; only bot review flagged pattern over-broadness; author closed the PR without merging ~1h later, no human engagement.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 298 lines added in a single file, this is a small configuration change. It was closed without merge despite being small, likely because the author decided not to proceed; no human reviewer engaged.

review_details.concern_detail: CodeRabbit bot suggested more precise ignore patterns (e.g., narrow the blanket `*.sh` exclusion) to avoid hiding useful files that would benefit Cursor indexing.
review_details.performance_claim: Excluding large generated artifacts and sensitive files from Cursor indexing improves editor speed and reduces resource consumption.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author closed PR after bot comments, no further engagement or merge; no explicit human rejection.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A simple config file addition was closed by the author without merging; no human reviewer engaged, suggesting low priority or uncertain value of the change.

detection_detail.code_reading: CodeRabbit bot reviewed .cursorignore patterns and flagged over-broad exclusions (e.g., *.sh, env.sample).

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance data, benchmark, or profiling evidence provided; only narrative claim about indexing speed.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no regression occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Added a .cursorignore file with patterns to exclude sensitive files (keys, credentials) and large generated artifacts (build outputs, node_modules, compilation outputs) to improve Cursor indexing performance and security.

review_signals.summary: CodeRabbit suggested narrowing `*.sh` exclusion, reconsidering env.sample hiding, and adding a comment for .d.ts ordering fragility.
Provided a walkthrough summarizing the new .cursorignore file as a chore to exclude sensitive and unnecessary files.
